stem.text: Two solid cylindrical objects X and Y are held fully submerged in a liquid, as shown.

stem.alt: Two vertical solid cylinders labelled X and Y, both fully below a horizontal line labelled surface of liquid.

stem.text: The objects have the same volume. The density of the material of Y is twice the density of the material of X. Both objects are stationary.

A.text: The force due to the liquid acting on the top surface of X is greater than that acting on the top surface of Y.

B.text: The pressure difference due to the liquid between the top and bottom surfaces of X is the same as that for Y.

C.text: The upthrust acting on X is the same as the upthrust acting on Y.

D.text: The weight of X is the same as the weight of Y.
